entity_extraction_config.description: Schema for extracting named entities and relationships from Jay Rosen's Internet Archive content
changelog: v3.0: Added 'Authored By' relationship, clarified 'Founded By', added negative examples
v3.0: Added record context awareness to prevent self-referential entities
extraction_focus: Organizations (news outlets, media companies, academic institutions, advocacy groups)
Works (books, major articles, papers, studies - NOT the current record being analyzed)
Concepts (journalism theories, media criticism frameworks, Jay Rosen's key concepts)
Events (conferences, elections, media crises, historical moments)
Locations (cities, countries, regions relevant to media/journalism context)

critical_rules.record_context: You are analyzing a RECORD from Jay Rosen's Internet Archive. The record itself (the article/post you're reading) should NOT be extracted as a new Work entity. Only extract OTHER works that are referenced within the text.
critical_rules.authorship_vs_founding: Use 'Authored By' when someone WROTE an article, book, or piece. Use 'Founded By' ONLY when someone CREATED an organization, publication outlet, or ongoing project (like PressThink the blog, not individual blog posts).
critical_rules.deduplication: If an entity appears multiple times with slight variations (e.g., 'Jay Rosen', 'Rosen', 'Professor Rosen'), consolidate to one canonical entity with the full name.

Person.description: Individual people mentioned in the text

Organization.description: Media organizations, news outlets, institutions, corporations, government bodies
Organization.note: Includes ongoing publications like 'PressThink' (the blog as a whole) but NOT individual articles

Work.description: Published works REFERENCED in the text - books, major reports, academic papers, influential articles. Do NOT create a Work entity for the record you are currently analyzing.

Concept.description: Journalism theories, media criticism frameworks, intellectual concepts

Event.description: Significant events, conferences, elections, media crises, historical moments

Location.description: Geographic locations relevant to media/journalism context

Authored By.description: Work A was written/authored by Person B. Use for articles, books, papers, posts.
examples: 'The Elements of Journalism' Authored By Bill Kovach
'Why Political Coverage Is Broken' Authored By Jay Rosen

Quoted.description: Person/Work A directly quotes Person B
examples: Jay Rosen Quoted Donald Trump saying...

Responds To.description: Work/Person A is responding to or rebutting Work/Person B
examples: Jay Rosen Responds To criticism from...

Mentions.description: Entity A mentions entity B in passing or substantively

Criticizes.description: Entity A criticizes or negatively evaluates entity B

Cites.description: Entity A cites or references entity B as source material

Discusses.description: Entity A discusses or analyzes concept/event B in depth

Expands On.description: Entity A expands, elaborates, or builds upon concept/work B

Affiliated With.description: Person A is affiliated, employed by, or associated with Organization B

Published In.description: Work A was published in/by Organization B

Originated By.description: Person A originated or coined Concept B

Occurred At.description: Event A occurred at Location B

Supports.description: Entity A supports, advocates for, or defends entity B

Owns.description: Organization/Person A owns or controls Organization B (media ownership, corporate structure)
examples: Jeff Bezos Owns The Washington Post

Founded.description: Person/Organization A founded Organization B. ONLY use for creating organizations, publications (as ongoing entities), or major projects. Do NOT use for writing individual articles.
do_not_use_for: Any content that someone 'wrote' rather than 'founded'

Pioneered.description: Person, Organization, or Concept A pioneered, invented, or was first to develop Concept or Work B
examples: Jay Rosen Pioneered 'View from Nowhere' concept

Inspired By.description: Work, Concept, or Person A was inspired by, influenced by, or built upon Work/Concept/Person B

negative_examples.description: Examples of INCORRECT extractions to avoid

wrong_extractions.text: This article by Jay Rosen discusses...
wrong_extractions.correct: Do not create a relationship for the current article. The record metadata already captures authorship.
wrong_extractions.reason: The current record IS the article - don't create a Work entity for it

wrong.relationship: Jay Rosen Founded PressThink (for every single post)

wrong_extractions.correct: Only create 'Jay Rosen Founded PressThink' ONCE in the entire archive, not for every post
wrong_extractions.reason: Founding is a one-time event, not repeated per article

wrong_extractions.text: In my latest post, I wrote about...
wrong_extractions.correct: Do not extract. This refers to the current record.

extraction_guidelines.prominence_threshold: Extract entities that are substantively discussed, not just mentioned in passing
extraction_guidelines.context_required: Include enough context to disambiguate entities (e.g., 'Jay Rosen, NYU professor' vs 'Jay Rosen')
extraction_guidelines.relationship_evidence: Relationships should be explicitly stated or strongly implied in the text
extraction_guidelines.entity_normalization: Standardize entity names (e.g., 'NYT' -> 'The New York Times')
extraction_guidelines.record_awareness: Remember: You are analyzing an existing archive record. Do not create entities for the record itself.

example_extraction.sample_text: In this piece, I criticize the Washington press corps for embracing what I call 'The Church of the Savvy.' As I discussed in my book 'What Are Journalists For?' the problem runs deep. Margaret Sullivan at The Washington Post has written about similar concerns. Jeff Bezos, who owns the Post, rarely intervenes in editorial matters.

expected_entities.note: Author of the current record - extracted as entity but NO 'Founded' relationship for this post

expected_entities.author: Jay Rosen
expected_entities.note: This IS a valid Work entity - it's a book referenced in the text, not the current record

expected_relationships.context: I criticize the Washington press corps
what I call 'The Church of the Savvy'
Margaret Sullivan at The Washington Post
Jeff Bezos, who owns the Post

entities_NOT_to_extract.wrong: Work entity for 'Why Political Coverage Is Broken'
entities_NOT_to_extract.reason: This is the current record (PRESSTH-00042), not a referenced work
He WROTE it (authorship is in record metadata), he didn't FOUND it
